**Gaurav Gopinath** is an Indian-American designer who has worked with Mattel initially as an intern in 2021 and full-time since 2022. Born in India and growing up in Saudi Arabia, he initially interned under the [Hot Wheels RC](/wiki/Hot_Wheels_RC) brand under [Tyler Charest](/wiki/Tyler_Charest). He currently works mainly on the [Matchbox](/wiki/Matchbox) line overseeing the Collector and Moving Parts lines as well as sometimes doing graphics for the vehicles in those lines.
